brief:
The user likes spy films, science fiction, and movies with lots of action. Science fiction interests them for its imagined future technologies and the idea that familiar human problems persist despite technological progress.

They have no fixed favorite movie; their choice changes. Dr. Strangelove and Full Metal Jacket are possible favorites. Stanley Kubrick is their favorite director. They praise Full Metal Jacket’s boot-camp/Vietnam structure, anti-war message, excellent acting, and intensity, and describe it as very well done.

They dislike Bowling for Columbine and broadly dislike films by its director, whose name they could not recall. Their objection centers on finding him pretentious and annoying, which makes the movie annoying to them. They jokingly describe themselves as pretentious too.

They have seen Pulp Fiction and think it is fantastic, especially for its violence, humor, cast, and smaller interwoven stories. They also praise the chemistry between cast members whom they associate with Die Hard, but the transcript is unclear about whom they mean and the details of that connection.

They may have seen The Accountant but cannot remember its plot; neither viewing status nor an opinion is established.
